slots.name: Patriot missile batteries deployed
slots.sentence: The U.S. has sent two additional Patriot missile batteries to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to help protect oil and gas facilities, Axios reported Thursday, citing two U.S. officials and another unnamed regional source.
